decisions.reason: As a safety shoe line in the firm’s core knowledge base that gained its own page by 2024, it is highly likely to be retained and further refined rather than withdrawn.
A comfort insole is closely related to the firm’s footwear expertise, so even with only modest website prominence the firm can learn from market feedback and keep improving it.
A supportive insole also fits the firm’s existing capabilities in protective footwear and foot support, making retention more likely than exit despite limited signs of strong market escalation.
An ergonomic safety shoe series sits squarely in the firm’s main competence area and kept a dedicated page across both years, which strongly supports continued commercialization.

Firefighter and rescue boots are an adjacent protective-footwear segment that the firm can understand and serve with its existing know-how, and the move to a dedicated page in 2024 suggests growing commitment.
The moulded insole is a flagship offering, remained on the home page, and showed a concrete customer use case, so the firm is very likely to keep backing it as a strategic direction.
